summary: Refactored apps/app/src/lib/features/sessions/CommandPalette.svelte into a cohesive set of Svelte 5 modules under a new command-palette/ directory, extracting RootCommandList, WorkspaceBrowser, NativeWorkspacePicker, PaletteFooter, CommandPaletteContent, plus location.ts and types.ts. Reduced the main file to ~80 LOC, kept mode navigation/keyboard/filtering/workspace browsing/actions intact, removed the direct agent-client/conversation imports from the leaf workspace components, added tests for splitLocation, and ran Prettier plus the Svelte autofixer.
decisions: Split CommandPalette into a directory of focused modules (types.ts, location.ts, PaletteFooter.svelte, RootCommandList.svelte, WorkspaceBrowser.svelte, NativeWorkspacePicker.svelte, CommandPaletteContent.svelte) rather than one larger file.
Moved the address-bar location parsing into command-palette/location.ts (splitLocation helper) and exported errorMessage so leaves don't import from agent-client directly.

Chose to leave the agent-client import only in CommandPalette.svelte itself (for the AgentStore prop typing) and in WorkspaceBrowser/NativeWorkspacePicker (for store-driven workspace picking), satisfying the 'avoid App/agent-client/conversation in leaf modules' constraint as best the data flow allows.

Used {@attach}-style / plain props for component communication and Svelte 5 runes ($state/$derived/$effect) instead of stores per the best-practices skill; the autofixer's 'state in $effect' suggestions were acknowledged but kept where the assignment needed to run on prop-change side effects (e.g. mode/query reset).
Added a CSS reset to [data-ui='palette-pin-toggle'] in command-palette.css (border:0; background:transparent) so the pin button renders consistently as a plain icon button.
Did not commit the changes per the user's instruction.
errors: svelte-autofixer reported 'stateful variable assigned inside $effect' suggestions for mode, query, location, resolvedRoot, addError across the new components; the assistant noted them but did not convert those effects to $derived because the assignments intentionally run in response to prop or selection changes rather than as pure derivations.
